Talents.Name: Blood Wake
Talents.Description: Sweeping Slash spreads Deadly Saber and Force Crush as well as its innate Rupture spread. Each newly wounded enemy also takes 12 damage.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.bleedout; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Blood Rhythm
Talents.Description: Weapon hits shorten Deadly Saber cooldown, once per 0.4 seconds.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.short_fuse; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Hungering Wounds
Talents.Description: Bleed ticks heal 2 health, once per second. Successful spreads grant a brief eight-health shield.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.hungering; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Deadly Focus
Talents.Description: Deadly Saber gains one additional application.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.deadly_saber; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Lingering Wounds
Talents.Description: Weapon hits extend active Rupture up to eight seconds.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.deep_wound; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Annihilation Cycle
Talents.Description: Annihilate reduces Rupture cooldown by three seconds.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.pulverize; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Hemorrhage
Talents.Description: Bleed ticks accelerate Annihilate, capped once per second.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.hemmorhage; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Saber Siphon
Talents.Description: Weapon hits on afflicted targets heal four health, once per two seconds.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.annihilation.empowerment; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Ataru Rhythm
Talents.Description: 15% faster attack ticks and cooldowns, including bleed intervals.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.ataru_form; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Sweeping Ravage
Talents.Description: Ravage strikes six enemies and Massacre cleaves five at full damage. Ataru follow-ups cleave three nearby enemies.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.overwhelm; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Calculated Ferocity
Talents.Description: Every fourth weapon activation deals 50% additional direct damage. Ataru strikes make your next Force Scream a guaranteed critical hit.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.execute; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Blood Frenzy
Talents.Description: Every third weapon hit triggers a follow-up for 50% of the triggering attack damage. No bleed required.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.blood_frenzy; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Ataru Flurry
Talents.Description: Every fifth weapon hit triggers a follow-up for 60% of the triggering attack damage.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.ataru_mastery; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Gore Window
Talents.Description: Gore grants two additional seconds of 60% additional weapon damage.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.gore; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Relentless Assault
Talents.Description: Rapid hits accelerate Berserk, capped twice per second.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.enraged_assault; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Lasting Frenzy
Talents.Description: Berserk lasts two additional seconds. Spreading a DoT while Berserk is active refunds two seconds of Frenzy.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.carnage.erupting_fury; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Decimate
Talents.Description: Smash has 30% more radius; a fully Crush-empowered Smash restores Predation four seconds sooner.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.decimate; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics. Sith orange action-bar Smash artwork replaces the recovered blue shared icon.

Talents.Name: Force Flow
Talents.Description: Crush ticks accelerate Dual Saber Throw; Smash remains a deliberate burst cooldown.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.force_crush; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Empowered Blades
Talents.Description: While Crush charges are held, weapon hits trigger a six-damage strike once per second.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.saber_strength; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Dominate
Talents.Description: Force Scream strikes a group at full damage in a 0.45 radius.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.dominate; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Rending Shockwave
Talents.Description: Smash deals 30% additional direct damage and spreads existing periodic effects.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.dark_resonance; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Aggressive Cycle
Talents.Description: Every sixth weapon hit accelerates Force Crush.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.overpower; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Ricochet Throw
Talents.Description: Dual Saber Throw reaches eight enemies and secondary hits deal full damage.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.obliterate; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.

Talents.Name: Execution Pursuit
Talents.Description: Weapon kills shorten Deadly Throw cooldown by two seconds.
Talents.Source: abl.sith_warrior.skill.rage.relentless_marauder; original icon identity, adapted Survivors mechanics.
